package.title: User contacts: persistent address book, /contacts route, DM get-or-create

specification.intent: The user gets a persistent contact list backed by the own backend (contacts table, one-directional: implicit capture when the owner adds a user to any chat, explicit add through the new /contacts route). The route reuses the messenger sidebar skeleton with the chat list replaced by contacts and a top «Добавить» button reusing the debounced user-search modal (existing contacts badged «уже в контактах»). Clicking a contact opens a menu: «Создать» (get-or-create 1:1 chat via POST /chats/dm on a new Chat.is_dm flag, then navigate to the open chat) and «Найти все чаты» (disabled stub, documented not-done). A hover cross removes a contact after confirmation (DELETE /contacts/{user_id}). Styles mirror the messenger breakpoints: 380px sidebar, 280px tablet, single column <768.

requirements.title: Contacts persistence: model, migration, repository, service, endpoints, implicit capture
requirements.description: Contact model (owner_id, contact_user_id composite PK, both FK users.id CASCADE, created_at server_default now) registered in models/__init__.py; migration 009_contacts creates the table and adds chats.is_dm; ContactRepository get/upsert (get-then-insert, the add_member idiom)/remove/list_for_owner (JOIN users, created_at DESC, contact_user_id DESC); ContactService list/add/remove with guards (self 400 contact_self_forbidden, unknown 404 user_not_found, missing row 404 contact_not_found) assembling ContactResponse {id = contact user id, login = lower email, display_name = local part (UserSearchItem rule), avatar_url, created_at}; endpoints/contacts.py (GET '' list, POST '' idempotent 201, DELETE '/{user_id}' 204/404) registered through the register_domain seam from endpoints/__init__.py; ChatService.add_member records the implicit contact (requester -> added user, skipped on self) on EVERY successful resolution — the fresh-insert path inside its existing transaction AND the existing-membership early return (its own commit; idempotent upsert) — with no members-endpoint response change; anonymous 401 on all routes; owner isolation.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (contacts from users found and added to chats; explicit add via search)

requirements.title: DM get-or-create: Chat.is_dm flag and POST /chats/dm
requirements.description: Chat.is_dm boolean (default False, server_default '0') via migration 009; ChatResponse gains additive is_dm: bool = False (model_validate fills it); ChatRepository.find_dm(a, b) = earliest is_dm chat containing both memberships (two IN-subqueries, id asc, limit 1); POST /api/v1/chats/dm body {user_id} registered BEFORE /{chat_id} (the /search precedent): existing DM 200, none -> create (title = target email local part, owner = caller, is_ai False, is_dm True, members caller+target) 201, self 400 dm_self_forbidden, unknown 404 user_not_found, anonymous 401; plain 2-member groups are never reused (find_dm filters is_dm, integration-pinned); list_chats passes is_dm=chat.is_dm explicitly in its field-by-field ChatResponse construction (POST /chats and GET /chats/{id} fill it via model_validate); documented edge: members endpoint can later grow a DM beyond two members (accepted); accepted race: two concurrent first DM calls can create two rows (no pair uniqueness, review F-7).
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (contact menu 'Создать' opens/creates the 1:1 chat)

requirements.title: Frontend logic: contacts feature module (ports, own adapter, store slice, controller, wiring)
requirements.description: ContactInfo UI type in utils/types.ts (no api import); CONTACTS = '/contacts' in utils/constants.ts; new self-sufficient src/features/contacts/ (features never import each other): ports.ts (ContactsPort: fetchContacts, addContact(userId), removeContact(userId), searchUsers(SearchUserData), createDm(userId) -> {chatId} — chat id ONLY: HTTPTransport resolves xhr.response alone (src/utils/HTTPTransport.ts:124-126), a created: 201-vs-200 flag is unimplementable within the write-sets and nothing consumes it (review F-1); local ContactSearchResult/DmChatResult types); api/own.ts (HTTPTransport('/contacts') GET/POST+csrf/DELETE+csrf, GET /users?login= on its own transport, POST /chats/dm +csrf mapping to {chatId: id}; avatar resolved avatar_url ?? avatarPoolUrl(id) at the single mapping point) + api/index.ts; store.ts contacts slice behind the in-slice cast idiom (chatSearch precedent, no utils/Store.ts edit); controller.ts singleton (fetch -> slice; add/remove -> refetch; searchUsers error -> []; openDm -> injected chatOpener(chatId)) + module-level setChatOpener (default noop); module.ts {name 'contacts', deps ['auth']}; features/index.ts registers the module and wires setChatOpener((chatId) => { ChatsController.selectChat(chatId); void ChatsController.getChatUsers(chatId); Router.go(MESSENGER) }) — the ONLY cross-feature seam (setProfileController precedent); /contacts protected by the existing allowlist guard, zero guard edits.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (route with contacts instead of chats, reuse user search)

requirements.title: Frontend UI: /contacts route, sidebar skeleton, add-modal reuse, contact menu, responsive styles
requirements.description: main.ts registers Routes.Contacts + Router.use(ContactsPage); bottomBar «Контакты» icon navigates Router.go(CONTACTS) with active state (Чаты unchanged); ContactItem component (components/contactItem/, double braces only, hover delete cross, registered in components.ts); renderAddUserModalContent gains optional alreadyBadge (default 'уже в чате', messenger unchanged) — the page passes 'уже в контактах' with memberIds = contact ids; ContactsPage (features/contacts/pages/contacts/): withStore slice, CDM fetchContacts, simplified sidebar (header «Контакты» + «Добавить», list, BottomBar; no stories row, no chat search bar), controller-free modal state in props, root-delegated input/click events, 300 ms debounce reusing USER_SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS, page-owned refocus; contact menu Modal («Создать» -> openDm + close; «Найти все чаты» disabled with 'пока не реализовано' title; «Отмена»); delete-confirm Modal -> removeContact; ChatPage chatPaneOpen initial = selectedChat != null (documented behaviour change, mocha-pinned); SCSS contacts.scss + contact-item.scss mirroring chat.scss breakpoints (380 / 280 tablet / single column <768, placeholder hidden); docs: NEXT.md feature record WITH the not-done note for «Найти все чаты», progress_log entry on top.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (contacts route, top «Добавить», menu Создать/Найти все чаты, delete with confirm, all resolutions)

specification.goal: A working contacts address book: implicit capture on chat-member adds, explicit add via the reused user-search modal, a menu that opens or creates the 1:1 chat, confirmed deletion, and a responsive /contacts route wired to the bottom bar.
constraints: Layers only downward (pages -> components -> controllers -> api -> utils -> core); guard-architecture --all --strict stays green; components never import features/controllers; UI types never import from api/; features never import each other — the only cross-feature seam is src/features/index.ts.

Migration 009_contacts is additive (new contacts table + chats.is_dm); alembic heads becomes 009_contacts (pinned by verify:backend = pytest + alembic heads only); the 009 upgrade and downgrade paths are proven INSIDE pytest by the segment roundtrip test backend/tests/integration/test_migration_009_contacts_segment.py (scratch SQLite file -> Base.metadata.create_all -> alembic stamp head -> downgrade -1 -> upgrade head, inspector-asserted both ways; a full-chain SQLite run is impossible by design — 008 CREATE EXTENSION pg_trgm and 005 ALTER-based create_foreign_key are PG-only, the full chain is exercised operationally on the compose PostgreSQL — review F-8).
All contacts/DM endpoints behind get_current_user; anonymous 401 pinned; owner-scoped isolation pinned; mutating frontend calls carry readCsrfToken().
Modal content HTML only through the escapeHtml builder; ContactItem double braces only; <script> payload renders as text (XSS test).
The contacts Store slice uses the in-slice cast idiom; utils/Store.ts AppState is NOT edited; the auth guard stays allowlist-based with zero changes.
Existing suites stay green; test counts grow from the 337 mocha / 184 pytest baseline (docs/NEXT.md, 2026-10-27).
The messenger add-user modal behaviour is bit-identical (alreadyBadge defaults to 'уже в чате').
chats.is_dm never reuses plain 2-member groups; POST /chats/dm is idempotent (200 same id on repeat).
nonGoals: implementing «Найти все чаты» — disabled stub, recorded as not-done in docs/NEXT.md (the chat-search work from the other machine is not merged)
two-way (symmetric) contacts — capture is one-directional (the adder gets the contact)
WS push of contact-list changes; live cross-tab contact sync (page CDM refetch is the refresh point)
contact import/export, favorites, editing, contact profile pages
server-side pagination of GET /contacts (full list, study scale)
DM member-count enforcement (a DM can later grow via the members endpoint; documented edge)
pair-uniqueness for concurrent POST /chats/dm — two simultaneous first calls can create two DM rows (accepted study-scale race)
unread badges / last-message snippets / any chat-list features on contact cards
deleting a contact deleting the DM chat or membership
specification.scope: backend contacts domain (model, migration 009, repository, service, endpoints, implicit capture in add_member, POST /chats/dm, pytest); frontend contacts feature module (types, constants, ports, adapter, store, controller, module, features/index wiring); frontend UI (route, bottom bar, ContactItem, page + modals, chatPaneOpen init, scss, docs) with mocha; evidence receipts under work/2026-11-01-contacts/.

criteria.title: Contacts CRUD + implicit capture proven by pytest
criteria.statement: GET /contacts returns the caller's ordered contacts (created_at DESC, contact_user_id DESC; empty list for a fresh user; id = contact user id); POST /contacts is idempotent (201 on create AND on existing; never duplicates), 400 contact_self_forbidden on self, 404 user_not_found on unknown; DELETE /contacts/{user_id} 204 then 404 contact_not_found; anonymous 401 everywhere; owner isolation (B never sees A's contacts); implicit capture — after A adds B to a chat A's list contains B and B's does not contain A, members endpoint response unchanged.

criteria.title: DM get-or-create proven by pytest
criteria.statement: POST /chats/dm: first call 201 (is_dm true, title = target email local part, owner = caller, exactly two members); repeat 200 with the SAME id; self 400 dm_self_forbidden; unknown 404 user_not_found; anonymous 401; a plain 2-member group is never reused (test creates one, then asserts a new chat id); GET /chats carries the additive is_dm field.

criteria.title: Additive migration 009_contacts
criteria.statement: 009_contacts creates the contacts table (composite PK, both FKs CASCADE, created_at server_default now) and adds chats.is_dm (NOT NULL, server_default '0') via batch_alter_table; alembic heads prints exactly 009_contacts (pinned by verify:backend, which runs pytest + alembic heads only — review F-2); the 009 upgrade AND downgrade paths are proven inside pytest by backend/tests/integration/test_migration_009_contacts_segment.py (scratch SQLite: create_all -> stamp head -> downgrade -1 -> upgrade head, inspector-asserted both ways — review F-8; a full-chain SQLite run is impossible because 008/005 are PG-only, the full chain is the compose-PostgreSQL operational path, not this gate); the existing pytest suite stays green with counts grown from the 184 baseline.

criteria.title: Contacts feature module proven by mocha
criteria.statement: The own adapter hits exactly GET /contacts, POST /contacts (+csrf), DELETE /contacts/{id} (+csrf), GET /users?login=, POST /chats/dm (+csrf) with URL shapes and DTO mapping mocha-pinned including the single avatar fallback point (avatar_url ?? avatarPoolUrl(id)); the contacts slice follows the in-slice cast idiom with no utils/Store.ts edit; the controller writes the slice on fetch, refetches after add/remove, returns [] on searchUsers port error, and passes the returned chatId to the injected opener (default noop pinned); features/index.ts wires the opener through ChatsController + Router.go(MESSENGER) as the only cross-feature seam; no component/page/scss file touched by this wave.

criteria.title: Route, sidebar, modals, responsive styles
criteria.statement: /contacts mounts ContactsPage protected by the existing allowlist guard (zero guard edits); the «Контакты» bottom-bar icon navigates to /contacts and renders active there while «Чаты» stays on /messenger (pinned); the sidebar shows header «Контакты» + «Добавить» + list + BottomBar without the stories row and chat search bar; CDM fetches contacts; the add-modal reuses renderAddUserModalContent with badge «уже в контактах» for existing contacts (messenger default «уже в чате» unchanged — pinned) with the 300 ms debounce and page-owned refocus; the contact menu's «Создать» calls openDm(id) and closes, «Найти все чаты» renders disabled with a 'пока не реализовано' title, «Отмена» closes (pinned); the delete-confirm «Удалить» calls removeContact(id) (pinned); ContactItem renders through double braces only — a <script> login renders as text (XSS test); chatPaneOpen initializes to selectedChat != null (pinned); SCSS mirrors the chat.scss breakpoints (380 / 280 / single column <768, placeholder hidden) — verified by the task review and the manual smoke note, NOT by mocha (review F-5).

securityGates.statement: All contacts/DM endpoints sit behind get_current_user (cookie JWT): anonymous 401 integration-pinned; contact rows are scoped strictly by owner_id — another user's contacts never appear (isolation-pinned); the DM endpoint never leaks chats the caller is not a member of (both memberships required by construction); mutating frontend calls carry readCsrfToken().

Modal slot HTML is built exclusively through the escapeHtml-based builder (renderAddUserModalContent precedent); ContactItem and page templates render user data through double braces only; a <script> payload in a login or display_name renders as text (mocha XSS test); triple braces exist only for the pre-escaped modal slot HTML.
